title: J.E. Ellison in Yard, 1950s Black & White Snapshot, Albuquerque NM
back_text_transcription:
Daddy,
J. E. Ellison
in yard 719 No. Girard.
Albuq
description: A mid-century black and white snapshot featuring an elderly man identified on the reverse as 'Daddy, J.E. Ellison'. He wears wire-rimmed glasses, a button-up shirt with a pocket chain, and stands outdoors next to a lush, flowering bush in the yard of 719 N. Girard in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The photograph features deckled edges characteristic of mid-20th century photo printing.
